purpose: Commercially useful Turkish solution-page titles for the existing 28 portfolio assets; not customer case studies.

method.sources: Current search retrieval plus first-party Turkish manufacturer and service-provider pages; source statements were paraphrased and used to corroborate market terminology only.

autocomplete.reason: The shell HTTP request did not execute: network approval was cancelled before a decision was returned. No autocomplete suggestions were obtained or inferred.

method.limitation: Supplier terminology and a quotation context establish plausible commercial intent, not query frequency, keyword difficulty, highest search potential or actual demand. Suggested titles and long-tail combinations are editorial inferences aligned with the existing asset subjects. Web retrieval dates are not publication dates. Search snippets may be cached.
method.selectionRule: Name the object and buying task clearly: part or model type plus design, manufacture, sample reproduction or quotation. Keep the existing slug and cover; use unique page copy answering inputs, scope, material decisions and quote requirements.
method.claimBoundary: No source here establishes the user's production capability, previous customer work, delivered quantity, tolerance, certificate or measured performance. Do not transfer competitors' claims. Keep a discreet, explicit illustrative-image caption; do not describe an illustrative image as a completed job.

sources.fact: The provider groups custom gripper fingers, end-effectors and sensor enclosures under a robot/automation production service.

sources.retrieval: search and opened page; redirected from partgo.co
sources.fact: The service page connects electronic enclosure manufacture with CAD submission and price quotation. Its machining process is not evidence of this brand's production capability.
The provider includes air-duct prototypes, special brackets and control-knob replacements among its custom 3D-printing applications.
The service is offered for existing parts without technical drawings, with measurement, CAD reconstruction and a quotation/contact path.
The manufacturer's Turkish catalogue describes modular electronic housings, PCB accommodation and configurable connection options.
The production service lists mounting aids, brackets, gripper parts and fixtures, accepting a file or sample information for an initial assessment.
The provider describes a master model as the starting point for silicone-mould small-series casting and links the service to quotation.
The provider offers models for residential, commercial and urban/masterplan presentations with a price-quotation call to action.
The provider discusses physical terrain models showing topography and the relation of buildings to their surroundings.
A model manufacturer offers a wind-energy installation model for explaining components and technical systems. This supports a specialist model-service term, not measured query demand.
The maker's catalogue includes floor-section models, topographic terrain models and industrial facilities such as factories.
The maker describes industrial models and cutaways as physical explanations of products or processes and provides a quotation path.

sources.retrieval: opened service heading plus domain-restricted search extraction
sources.fact: The provider offers custom jigs and fixtures; search extraction explicitly distinguishes assembly, measurement, test and quality-control operations. The opened body extraction was limited to navigation and heading.

sources.query: özel plastik yedek parça dişli imalatı tersine mühendislik kablo kılavuzu
sources.fact: The producer accepts drawings or samples for custom engineering-plastic components; its listed uses include conveyor guides and wear parts. Its machining method is not attributed to the user's brands.

sources.query: montaj braketi sistemleri sensör; domain leuze.com
sources.retrieval: manufacturer search extraction; independent open timed out
sources.fact: The Turkish manufacturer catalogue offers mounting-bracket systems and rod-mounted brackets for sensors.
The Turkish manufacturer markets thermoform/vacuum tooling for automotive, appliance and machine applications. The existing portfolio asset is a model, so its title must retain that scope.

sources.query: özel plastik yedek parça dişli imalatı tersine mühendislik kablo kılavuzu
sources.fact: The manufacturer's quotation page asks for a drawing or sample and operating conditions; it lists engineering plastics among possible materials. No mechanical-performance claim is transferred.
The Turkish catalogue contains a named control-knob product with a flat cover. This establishes component vocabulary; custom manufacture is the proposed page's editorial framing.

editorialPriorities.basis: Clear buying task plus asset fit, not numerical search-volume ranking.

implementationNotes: Keep one distinct primary purpose per entry; avoid repeating the same generic 3D-printing pitch across 28 pages.
Describe quotation inputs such as model or sample, mating geometry, quantity and operating conditions. Do not invent fixed prices or turnaround promises.
Existing titles may be edited naturally; this mapping is a research recommendation, not an exact-copy requirement.
Retain current URLs and covers unless an independent visual review identifies a mismatch. Update title, excerpt, headings, internal links and image alt text consistently.
Use solution/application framing on index and detail pages. Do not present illustrative work as completed customer references.
